Name: Potatoes' HD Portrait for Daulton
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
I found Daulton's mod literally today and immediately wanted to play with it. But all characters in my game have non-pixel art style portraits. I searched to see if someone had already done new portraits for Daulton, but no such luck, so I made this. Sharing in case other people want another look for Daulton's portraits as well.
[b]
[/b][color=#dbb0a7][b]Update 15 January 2026: [/b][/color]Remade all this mod's art. The older ones were made very quickly, like in an hour quick, so I could play with the mod. But now, a year later, I actually sat down and did something Daulton deserves :) hope you guys like it.
[b]28/01/26:[/b] Fixed Island/Beach Portraits showing up at the wrong time. Please delete old Daulton_Beach Portrait.

[b][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/1jMpQSJ.png[/img][/center][/b]

[list]
[*] This mod changes all his portraits (Seasons + Beach), but not his sprites. His outfits are still the same!
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]

This mod is made to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraitPlus[/url]. I have not tested trying to make it work HD with only CP, but you're free to try.

[color=#dbb0a7]﻿1. [/color]Download this mod.
﻿[color=#dbb0a7]2[/color][color=#dbb0a7].[/color] Unzip, then copy the PNGs files that are inside this mod's folder.
﻿[color=#dbb0a7]3[/color][color=#dbb0a7].[/color] Paste the PNG files into[b] Mods/Portraiture/Portrait/(Your Portraits folder).[/b]
﻿You're done ^^

Hope you enjoy it :)
